baseline_run.description: Replayed frozen baseline labels from failure_recall_study_001 and assumption_recall_study_001 without taxonomy fields.

candidate_retrospective_assumption_resco.basis: Taxonomy-assisted rescore of 13 candidate retrospective assumptions from assumption_recall_study_001.md. Found credit is assigned where an explicit category directly targets the hidden assumption: PROXY_DEPENDENCY, DUPLICATE_CLUSTER, REGIME_DEPENDENCY, CONTEXT_OMISSION, MECHANISM_MISMATCH, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Remaining cases stay PARTIAL because candidate-specific parameter/detail risk still needs artifact-specific review.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A mature architecture implies comparable maturity in outcome evidence, sleeve evidence, and factory claims.
case_results.known_constraint: Architecture readiness and empirical validation mature on different timelines.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Architecture maturity was mistaken for evidence maturity.

case_results.hidden_assumption: More paper tracking artifacts mean authority readiness has improved.
case_results.known_constraint: Paper lifecycle artifacts and live readiness gates answer different governance questions.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Paper workflow progress was mistaken for runtime readiness progress.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Accumulated observations and open paper positions quickly convert into resolved evidence.
case_results.known_constraint: Outcome maturation requires elapsed time and closed samples.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Observation accumulation was mistaken for meaningful outcome evidence.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A larger raw signal or candidate count indicates better research progress.
case_results.known_constraint: Certification, portfolio gates, and evidence quality limit useful candidate flow.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Candidate volume was treated as a proxy for candidate quality.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A technical indicator pattern that appears broadly supported will survive relationship-specific review.
case_results.known_constraint: Broad support and baseline recoverability do not prove relationship-specific signal quality.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Standalone technical-indicator claims failed fixture review.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Active sleeve status implies a sleeve can produce candidate flow.
case_results.known_constraint: Some sleeves had no signals or lacked required data.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Active sleeves did not produce broadly distributed candidate flow.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Enough research documentation implies readiness for capital review.
case_results.known_constraint: Evidence remained underpowered or blocked despite richer artifacts.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Research artifacts existed, but no hypotheses were ready for capital review.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Desired architecture state is enough to retire legacy runtime dependencies.
case_results.known_constraint: Runtime truth still consumed legacy artifacts.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Legacy compatibility layers could not be retired by architecture decision alone.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Workflow expansion can compensate for absent macro readiness evidence.
case_results.known_constraint: Missing or immature data cannot be repaired by inventing authority.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Macro readiness gaps could not be repaired by expanding workflow behavior.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Passing or mostly clean audits means the research conclusions are understood.
case_results.known_constraint: Auditability and understanding maturity are related but not identical.
case_results.known_failure_mode: A clean audit state was mistaken for mature research understanding.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Low output from a sleeve means the sleeve itself is low quality.
case_results.known_constraint: Non-production can reflect healthy no-candidate states, valid no-signal states, data needs, or conversion bottlenecks.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Low sleeve candidate production was misdiagnosed as poor sleeve quality.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A warning that does not block today can be ignored as a cleared or one-day condition.
case_results.known_constraint: Non-blocking warning status can still represent persistent candidate-integrity and sleeve-health issues.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Recurring integrity warnings were treated as operational noise.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Standalone indicator evidence can support durable strategy claims without mechanism and regime specificity.
case_results.known_constraint: Claims lacked relationship-specific support, out-of-fixture generalization, or separation from naive baselines.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Standalone technical-indicator evidence did not support durable Technical Strategy Factory claims.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A repeated opening-range memory can be reused without testing regime compatibility.
case_results.known_constraint: Opening-range evidence was generated-only and not validation.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Opening-range memory carried a regime mismatch warning.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A ready backlog item with an artifact can be executed by the available worker set.
case_results.known_constraint: Research item execution requires a compatible connected worker before useful processing can occur.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Selected backlog item had no compatible connected worker.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Referenced source artifacts exist and can be loaded from the artifact store.
case_results.known_constraint: Artifact lineage must resolve before priority influence or certification can run.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Priority or certification path referenced a missing artifact.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Backlog selection implies all input artifacts are available.
case_results.known_constraint: Selected backlog work cannot proceed when declared input artifacts are absent.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Input artifact loading failed for a selected human-review failure-analysis item.

case_results.hidden_assumption: Passing lineage and governance is enough for autonomous research execution to proceed.
case_results.known_constraint: All required safety gates must pass; lineage and governance pass status do not compensate for certification failure.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Autonomous research failed closed after certification failure despite lineage and governance passing.

case_results.hidden_assumption: A smaller blocker count means the certification state is close enough for execution.
case_results.known_constraint: Reduced blocker count is not equivalent to certification pass.
case_results.known_failure_mode: Research OS certification remained blocked even after blocker count dropped.

decision_rationale: Failure recall improves materially over the 23.7% baseline while authority violations remain 0 and all generated evaluation outputs remain GENERATED_ONLY. Refine taxonomy precedence rules before any broader integration.

false_positive_notes.false_positive_definition: A non-material or incorrect taxonomy objection. Ambiguous but relevant category matches are tracked separately, not counted as false positives.

taxonomy_enhanced_run.description: Applied Atlas Failure Taxonomy categories from the frozen taxonomy validation mapping to the same 19-case historical failure set.
